observed_prior: Exposed validation cross-fit t1 offsets 0.5319 vs ridge 0.4971; includes target-derived unit and reused validation.
primary_hypothesis: Causal input-state offsets improve t1 over affine ridge calibration on sequence-disjoint evaluation without target-derived classes.
mechanism_contrast: Conditional center shift (offsets) versus reliability/slope change (gains), and scoring-selection transport versus ordinary training calibration.
base: Reconstruct original weighted ridge using 48 train row groups seed2, every fourth required row; raw112+diff112+causal19 states; original ridge strength.
calibration_sources: 32 train row groups seed260103 excluding all known or potentially inspected train recipes
exposed 40 valid row groups seed1, scored rows only
evaluation: 64 valid row groups seed260104 excluding known40 seed1, known40 seed0, direct peeks0/5/6/7 and reconstructed default stream600 seed7; freshness versus actual undocumented stream invocation is unproven; not campaign-independent.
controls: affine plus additive three-bin state offsets
preprocessing: Calibration statistics and thresholds from that source only; targets clipped to +/-2, fit weights abs(y)+0.001; calibration ridge penalty 0.001*N on state coefficients, affine coefficients unpenalized; never target U.
primary_success_rule: On disjoint evaluation, t1 offset-minus-affine global WP >=0.005 with same positive sign in both deterministic sequence halves; report t0 and average metric even if negative.
rejection_rule: Reject useful transport of this small offset representation if t1 delta <0.005 or either sequence half nonpositive; if only exposed-scored calibration wins, ordinary-train transport is rejected.
secondary_threshold_test: Three-bin additive offsets must exceed linear offsets in average global WP by >=0.003 with positive signs in both halves; otherwise reject this cheap threshold representation.
causality: All states update on every row, including warm-up/unscored rows; reset per sequence; no seq_ix feature, no mask at inference, no future-dependent state or target-derived classes.
uncertainty: Paired sequence sufficient statistics; sequence bootstrap is descriptive under a cluster-independence assumption. Campaign connected components unavailable, so no campaign confidence claim.
provenance: Record row-group IDs, actual seq_ix, sampled input/target/mask checksums, input warm-up fingerprints, source hashes and exact command. Exclude exact input-prefix duplicates between development/evaluation before scoring.
